article.title: iPhone manufacturing in India gets a tariff boost
article.summary: As reported by Reuters , India continued its push to become a larger electronics manufacturing hub today by removing import duties on select parts used in smartphones and other devices. Here are the details.
article.title_zh: 印度 iPhone 製造獲得關稅提升
article.summary_zh: 據路透社報導，印度今日透過移除智慧型手機及其他設備零件的進口稅，繼續推進成為更大電子製造樞紐的目標。

article.title: UK still has Europe's worst 5G a year after VodafoneThree merger
article.summary: The merger between Vodafone and Three was supposed to improve 5G in the UK, but it sits at the bottom of Opensignal's latest ranking of network experience in Europe.
article.title_zh: 英國在 Vodafone Three 合併一年後仍為歐洲 5G 最差
article.summary_zh: Vodafone 和 Three 的合併原本應改善英國 5G，但在 Opensignal 最新的歐洲網絡體驗排名中位列最後。

article.title: Goldman Bans Staff From Prediction-Market Bets on Finance, War
article.summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. has banned employees from trading on prediction markets except for sports and entertainment bets, in one of the most pointed efforts by a Wall Street firm grappling with the new regulatory issues raised by the boom in betting on events.
article.title_zh: Goldman Sachs 禁止員工在預測市場上進行金融和戰爭相關投注
article.summary_zh: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. 禁止員工在預測市場上交易，僅限於體育和娛樂賭注，這是華爾街公司應對預測事件熱潮所帶來的新監管問題的最明確舉措之一。

article.title: FCC router ban docket stays active
article.summary: With the FCC granting more conditional approvals and waivers for broadband routers, CTIA and WNC are now seeking special dispensation.
article.title_zh: FCC 路由器禁令檔案保持活躍
article.summary_zh: 隨著 FCC 批准更多寬頻路由器的有條件批准和豁免，CTIA 和 WNC 現在尋求特殊豁免。

article.title: OpenAI unveils ChatGPT Work agent, GPT-5.6 models now available
article.summary: OpenAI held its second livestream this week today at 10 am PT. The video teased that the company was “introducing the next chapter for ChatGPT” today. OpenAI has openly discussed bringing Codex workflows into the main ChatGPT app for some time now. Today’s release includes a new ChatGPT Work agent, an upgraded ChatGPT desktop app with Codex included, and a new hosted sites service for OpenAI customers.
article.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Work 代理，GPT-5.6 模型現已上線
article.summary_zh: OpenAI 發佈新的 ChatGPT Work 代理和 GPT-5.6 模型，將 Codex 工作流整合至主應用程式。

article.title: The Expansion Of LPDDR Into Edge AI Platforms
article.summary: As artificial intelligence continues its migration from centralized data centers to distributed systems, one reality is becoming unmistakable: the future of AI is increasingly defined at the edge. Whether embedded in smart cameras, industrial controllers, or next-generation vehicles, AI is no longer confined to racks of GPUs. It is operating in power-constrained, thermally limited, and space-restricted environments where system design priorities are fundamentally different. In this new landscape, memory has emerged as a first-order design constraint. And with that shift, LPDDR is rapidly expanding beyond its mobile roots to become a foundational technology for edge and automotive AI platforms. The underlying driver is simple but profound. article.title_zh: LPDDR 在邊緣 AI 平台中的擴展
article.summary_zh: 隨著人工智能從集中式數據中心遷移到分佈式系統，AI 的未來日益由邊緣定義，無論是嵌入智能相機、工業控制器還是下一代車輛。

article.title: A Startup That Builds AI Agents Used One to Raise $100 Million
article.summary: A startup that helps enterprises build AI agents proved the technology’s value in the most practical way possible: by deploying one during its own fundraising.
article.title_zh: 構建AI代理的新創用AI完成1億美元融資
article.summary_zh: 幫助企業構建AI代理的新創以最實際的方式證明了該技術的價值：在自身融資中部署AI代理。

article.title: An AI agent startup just let its agent run its $100M fundraise
article.summary: Lyzr, a startup that builds AI agents for enterprises, used its own AI agent to raise a $100 million round — proof, evidently, that the product actually works.
article.title_zh: 一家 AI Agent 新創公司讓其 Agent 執行 1 億美元融資
article.summary_zh: 為企業構建 AI Agent 的新創公司 Lyzr 使用自己的 AI Agent 融資 1 億美元，證明該產品確實有效。

article.title: Google Photos’ latest UI experiment has one job: getting CapCut on your phone
article.summary: Credit: Shimul Sood / Android Authority TL;DR Google is testing a new set of sharing features in Google Photos. Among these is an option to share and edit media using CapCut. If you don’t have the app installed, it will prompt you to download it from the Play Store. Google appears to be testing a range of minor tweaks in Google Photos. These include a new name for a feature that makes video editing effortless , as well as a way to gamify your Memories . Along with these, we’ve discovered another change that appears to be pushing a popular third-party video editing app. You’re reading an Authority Insights story. Authority Insights brings you all the latest exclusive reports, app teardowns, leaks, and in-depth tech coverage from the Android Authority team that you won’t find anywhere else.
article.title_zh: Google Photos 最新的 UI 實驗有一個工作：將 CapCut 裝到你的手機上
article.summary_zh: Google 正測試 Google Photos 中的新分享功能，包括使用 CapCut 分享和編輯媒體的選項。

article.title: Report: Apple interested in startup that runs giant AI models on iPhone without servers
article.summary: The Information reports that Apple may be interested in PrismML’s technology. The firm is focused on shrinking AI models that generally require servers to function, offering on-device functionality with comparable intelligence.
article.title_zh: 報告：Apple 對於在 iPhone 上運行大型 AI 模型而不需要伺服器的新創公司感興趣
article.summary_zh: The Information 報導 Apple 可能對 PrismML 技術感興趣，該公司致力於縮減通常需要伺服器才能運行的 AI 模型，提供具有可比智能的設備端功能。

article.title: One of the first Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 flagship phones could be a spec monster
article.summary: TL;DR The Xiaomi 18 Pro is leaked to feature a 2nm flagship SoC (likely the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 or Gen 6 Pro) and a massive ~7,000mAh battery with 100W wired charging, and wireless charging. It could also pack in two 200MP cameras: an ultra-large primary sensor and a large-sensor telephoto macro. camera. Due to an industry-wide RAM crisis, a noticeable price bump is expected, but these spec bumps could help lessen the sticker shock. Qualcomm is expected to launch the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 series at its annual Snapdragon Summit event in Hawaii on September 24, 2026. With this new SoC series, we’re expecting a wave of new Android flagships to follow, and one of the first could be the Xiaomi 18 Pro . article.title_zh: 首批 Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 旗艦手機之一可能成為規格怪獸
article.summary_zh: Xiaomi 18 Pro 據洩露將搭載 2nm 旗艦 SoC 和約 7,000mAh 大電池、100W 有線充電及無線充電，並配備兩顆 200MP 相機。

article.title: OpenAI launches an AI agent built to automate your entire job
article.summary: Credit: Edgar Cervantes / Android Authority TL;DR OpenAI has launched ChatGPT Work alongside GPT 5.6. The new agent can gather context across apps, files, and workflows to create documents, spreadsheets, and presentations. ChatGPT Work works on mobile, web, and desktop. After a short preview period to give the Trump Administration time to review security concerns, OpenAI is officially debuting GPT 5.6 . With GPT 5.6, the company is releasing three models: Sol, Terra, and Luna. But that’s not the only reveal the company has today, as it also introduced ChatGPT Work. Today, OpenAI announced the launch of ChatGPT Work. This new agent can gather context across apps, files, and workflows to create documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and web apps. article.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 AI 代理，可自動化您的整個工作
article.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Work 代理，可跨應用、檔案和工作流收集上下文，創建文件、試算表和簡報。

article.title: Meta debuts Muse Spark 1.1 — its first paid AI model
article.summary: Meta on Thursday rolled out Muse Spark 1.1, a major update to its AI platform, just three months after launching its first model under AI chief Alexandr Wang. The launch appears to be a sign of just how urgently Meta Platforms CEO Mark Zuckerberg wants to close the gap with OpenAI and Anthropic. Wang described Muse Spark 1.1 in a recent CNBC interview as the lab’s “strongest model for agentic and coding work yet.” The first Muse Spark, internally called Avocado, shipped in April under a closed partner program with no public-facing API. This time around, Meta is opening a developer portal with a public waitlist. Don’t expect to find it on OpenRouter or other third-party marketplaces, though — Meta is keeping distribution on its own servers for now. It’s t
article.title_zh: Meta 推出 Muse Spark 1.1 — 其首個付費 AI 模型
article.summary_zh: Meta 於周四推出了 Muse Spark 1.1，這是其 AI 平台的重大更新，距離 AI 主管 Alexandr Wang 推出首個模型僅三個月。此舉表明 Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg 急於縮小與 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的差距。

article.title: OpenAI, Microsoft & Anthropic agree on who runs the agent. They disagree on what you can take back.
article.summary: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Work on July 9 and began rolling it out to Pro, Enterprise, and Edu users. It runs on the new GPT-5.6, opens a user’s local files, edits Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 documents, and carries a multi-step task through to a finished deliverable. Reuters placed it directly against Anthropic’s Claude Cowork , and both target the same person — a non-coder who wants the power of a coding agent without the terminal. Counting Anthropic, Microsoft, Perplexity, and Amazon, five leading labs have now released an agent of this kind. The batch shows that the newest agents are organized more by their intended users than by their functions. article.title_zh: OpenAI、Microsoft 和 Anthropic 在誰執行 agent 上達成共識，但在你能取回什麼上存在分歧
article.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 7 月 9 日宣布推出 ChatGPT Work，運行在新的 GPT-5.6 上，可開啟用戶本地文件、編輯 Google Workspace 和 Microsoft 365 文件，並將多步驟任務完成至最終交付物。
